# Daily Watercolor

> > A Richmond BC-based artist's portfolio showcasing daily watercolor paintings, mixed media works, and detailed painting technique tutorials.

Daily Watercolor is the professional website of Peter Lau, a Canadian artist specializing in watercolor, acrylic, and mixed media paintings. The site features his artistic portfolio, step-by-step painting tutorials, and artist statement, with a focus on daily creative practice and experimental techniques.

## Key Topics

- Peter Lau
- Watercolor painting
- Watercolor techniques
- Painting tutorials
- Ink resist technique
- Acrylic art
- Mixed media

- Richmond BC
- Federation of Canadian Artists
- Daily practice
- Gradated wash

- [Peter Lau - Artist Statement & Biography](https://www.dailywatercolor.com): Peter Lau's artist biography and statement, Richmond BC watercolorist
- [Watercolor Paintings Portfolio](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/painting-progress): Peter Lau's watercolor paintings portfolio and progress gallery
- [Acrylic and Mixed Media Paintings](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/acrylic): Peter Lau's acrylic and mixed media artwork portfolio gallery

## Watercolor Painting Techniques

- [Watercolor Ink Resist Painting Technique - Ballroom Passion](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/watercolor-ink-resist-painting-technique-ballroom-passion-watercolor-art): Step-by-step ink resist painting technique with tempera and India ink
- [Ballroom Dance Watercolor Ink Resist Painting](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/ballroom-dance-watercolor-ink-resist-painting-ink-resist-technique): Ink resist painting technique tutorial with tempera and watercolor
- [Watercolor Painting - Flower Arrangement (Washing Off Technique)](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/watercolor-painting-flower-arrangement-washing-off-technique): Watercolor painting tutorial on washing off technique for backgrounds
- [Ballroom Dancing Watercolor Painting and Gradated Wash](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/ballroom-dancing-painting-and-gradated-wash): Watercolor lesson on gradated wash technique for ballroom dance painting

## Daily Painting Studies

- [Daily Watercolor Painting - Orchid Watercolor Painting](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/daily-watercolor-painting-orchid-watercolor-painting-2): Orchid watercolor painting process using Winsor Newton on cold press paper
- [Daily Watercolor Painting - Flower Closeup](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/daily-watercolor-painting-flower-closeup-watercolor-painting-1): Watercolor painting tutorial: flower closeup technique on Arches paper
- [Watercolor Painting - Garden Sheep Sheer Hand Forged](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/watercolor-painting-garden-sheep-sheer-hand-forged): Step-by-step watercolor painting tutorial using hand-forged garden shears
- [Daily Watercolor - Orchid Watercolor Painting](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/daily-watercolor-orchid-watercolor-painting-2): Orchid watercolor painting with layering and color mixing techniques
- [Daily Watercolor - Abstract Landscape with Ink Outline](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/daily-watercolor-abstract-lanscape-watercolor-painting-watercolor-and-ink-outline): Abstract landscape watercolor with ink outline on Arches cold press paper

## Featured Artwork & Paintings

- [Abstract Watercolor Painting - Flower](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/abstract-watercolor-painting-flower): Abstract watercolor flower painting on Arches cold press paper
- [Daily Watercolor Painting - Abstract #2 with Black Marker](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/daily-watercolor-painting-abstract-2-watercolor-and-black-marker): Abstract watercolor painting with black marker mixed media technique
- [Red Chili Pepper Watercolor Painting](https://www.dailywatercolor.com/red-chili-pepper): Red chili pepper watercolor study using artist trading card format
